Ben / Marissa / Karthik —

Quick summary: PeregrineMed (enterprise health-tech) is requesting a ~30% list concession for Hosted API usage for their production rollout. They have a credible ramp (see attached forecast) and are offering a reference + multi-region expansion.

What I propose to keep risk low but be commercial: 28% off Hosted API list pricing for the first 12 months, contingent on:
- Signed mutual action plan and SOW (6 month minimum commit; auto-renew for any unused credits)
- Usage SLAs for response times in our region (we can offer standard SLA; ops baseline will be included)
- No other commercial concessions (no add'l credits, seats, or free infra)

Attachments: Peregrine_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf, updated forecast (from Alex).

This is >20% so I need senior approval to sanction. Ben — can you confirm this aligns with sales strategy for strategic references? Marissa — legal OK on the clause set in the MAP? Karthik — deal desk: any contraints from pricing controls (we've pushed similar before, but want thumbs up).

If everyone agrees, can we escalate for Marcus' sign-off today? Peregrine needs an answer within 72 hours.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov

+1 from me.

Context: Peregrine is a strategically attractive reference in the telehealth vertical and their usage profile (large short-lived inference workloads per patient session) aligns with our batch/caching optimizations—should drive good unit economics after Q1 of production.

28% for year one with the conditions Olga listed is reasonable. A few operational notes:
- Recommend a staged credit drawdown tied to milestones in the MAP (pilot completion -> full roll out -> multi-region enablement)
- Finance to track as a contra-revenue line under the deal id; limits future concessions for 18 months

Marissa/Karthik: if legal and deal desk confirm neutral terms, please escalate to Marcus for exec sign-off. Happy to take the reference and commit to an internal case study.

Thanks all — reviewed. Approve a one-time 28% Hosted API usage concession for PeregrineMed subject to the following conditions:
1) Signed MAP and SOW reflecting the 6-month minimum commit and the milestone-based drawdown Ben recommended.
2) Legal to finalize the reference language and confirm IP/PI protections (Marissa, please prioritize).
3) Finance to mark the concession as a contra-revenue item under DEAL-2028-PEREG-0037 and restrict further commercial concessions for 18 months.
4) No stacking with other promotional credits; all discounts apply to Hosted API billed usage only.

Olga — please coordinate with the customer to get the MAP signed by EOD Friday and loop me in on the final DocuSign link. Once legal signs off, Finance and Sales Ops will provision the credit schedule.
